title: Asynchronous entity extraction and the entity confirm step
description:
As a submitter, I want to confirm or fix the entities found in my link after it has been read, so that the knowledge base stays accurate without making me wait.

Notes: after submit the item shows "we are reading the link". A worker (not a Lambda; heavy extraction dependencies stay out of Lambda bundles) fetches text, runs the typed-entity extractor (Biblicus: blbs-81ec10; backend chosen by the evaluation story blbs-e14d5c) and posts proposals on the existing steering-proposal rails. The submitter then confirms, fixes or removes entities on the item page. "Save draft" is browser-only and says so. LLM tasks default to the cheap GPT-6 Luna tier unless stated otherwise.

```gherkin
Feature: Asynchronous extraction
  Scenario: Extraction completes later
    Given a pending submission
    When the extraction worker finishes
    Then the item gains proposed entities in state "proposed"
    And the submitter sees a confirm, fix or remove step

  Scenario: Extraction fails
    When the worker fails or times out
    Then the submission stays public and pending
    And the failure is recorded for staff without exposing internals to readers

  Scenario: No extraction in the request
    When a reader submits
    Then no extraction code runs inside the submit request
```
